# grav-gpu — Multi-GPU VRAM-Resident CUDA TreePM & FoF Cosmological N-Body Engine

> Open-source CUDA/C++ cosmological gravity solver by Haina Huang (CUHK Astrophysics) engineered to evolve up to 1024^3 dark-matter particles resident in GPU VRAM without host-to-device round-trips, cross-validated against SWIFT and Gadget-4.

## Canonical URLs
- Showcase (中文): https://hainahuang729.github.io/grav-gpu/
- Showcase (English): https://hainahuang729.github.io/grav-gpu/en.html
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/HainaHuang729/grav-gpu
- Author Portal: https://formless-observatory.wuxiangguan.workers.dev/projects

## Technical Summary
- Architecture: cuFFT 3D Particle-Mesh (PM) long-range force + warp-cooperative GPU Octree / Barnes-Hut short-range Tree force + GPU Friends-of-Friends (FoF) halo finder + Gadget-2 HDF5 snapshot I/O.
- Cross-Code Validation: Verified at 256^3 and 1024^3 particle scales against SWIFT and Gadget-4 for Layzer-Irvine energy conservation (~0.01% class) and nonlinear matter power spectrum accuracy P(k).
